name: spaceos
description: Ask plain questions about your SpaceOS business: sales, orders, customers, events, bookings, stock and more.

interface.longDescription:
SpaceOS for ChatGPT lets business owners and managers ask questions about their own business data in SpaceOS, the platform they use to run venues, cafés, shops, sports clubs and events. Ask how last weekend's sales compared, who bought tickets for Friday's show, which courts are free on Saturday morning, or what is running low on stock.

You sign in to SpaceOS and the connection covers one space, with the permissions of the person who signed in. It reads sales and orders across every channel, customers, events and attendees, bookings, stock, kitchen, expenses, payroll totals and other modules the space uses, and answers link back to the matching SpaceOS page.

Customer phone numbers and emails stay masked in lists. The connection is read-only: it cannot refund, edit, delete or send anything. Answers only cover the space you signed in to.
defaultPrompt: How did sales go this week, and what sold best?
Which products are running low on stock?
What bookings do we have tomorrow?

positive.prompt: How did our shop sales go today, and what were the best sellers?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives today's recognised revenue and order count for the demo space and a ranked list of products by billed value, with links to SpaceOS reports.

positive.prompt: Which products are running low on stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists product variants at or below their reorder point with units left, scarcest first, and notes when a default reorder point was used.
Lists customers with orders and spend; phone numbers and emails are masked.

positive.prompt: What bookings did we have last month, and which resource was busiest?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises bookings for the period with use by resource; says so plainly if there are none.

positive.prompt: What can you see in my SpaceOS space?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the feature modules switched on for the connected space.

negative.prompt: Show me the sales of a different business on SpaceOS.

negative.description: Bulk export of customer contact details
negative.prompt: List every customer's phone number and email.

review.commerce_description: SpaceOS for ChatGPT only reads business data. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read-only questions about sales, orders, customers, events, bookings, stock and other SpaceOS modules.
